subject: Novexa MAP: evaluation timeline at risk
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@novexa.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Novexa MAP: evaluation timeline at risk

Jasmine / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the tech looked promising. We started circulating the MAP to procurement and our security reviewers, and two blockers popped up that will push our close:

- Procurement needs a final price confirmation + updated SOW before the 08/15 internal approval.
- Security has a short SOC2 evidence ask and wants a briefing from engineering (they requested a 2‑week window to validate).

I attached the MAP we received (Novexa_MAP_v1.xlsx). At the moment, the internal approval committee is signalling that without procurement clarity we’ll likely slide our internal decision date from 08/20 to ~09/05. That would break the acceptance window we discussed.

Can Redwood propose a condensed evaluation cadence or a mitigation play we can present to leadership? Specifically: can you (a) provide an expedited SOC2 evidence package and (b) confirm a 30‑day pilot price that procurement can sign off?

Appreciate a short plan by EOD Tuesday so I can take it to my procurement lead.

— Asha
Asha Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novexa Therapeutics

Attachment: Novexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet of milestones / owners)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Asha Rao <asha@novexa.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novexa MAP: evaluation timeline at risk

Asha — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the MAP.

Quick summary of our proposal to avoid the 09/05 drift:

1) SOC2 / security evidence: Marissa (CS) will assemble a targeted evidence packet (controls matrix, relevant audit artifacts, and an engineering briefing doc) and we can host a 45‑minute security walkthrough with your reviewers by 08/07.

2) Pilot pricing + SOW: we can offer a 30‑day pilot at an introductory unit price and a one‑page SOW addendum. Karthik (legal/procurement) will draft the addendum for procurement review and circulate a DocuSign link by 08/06.

3) Condensed eval cadence (MAP v2): attached is a condensed MAP (Novexa_MAP_v2.xlsx) that re‑orders milestones, moves internal validation earlier, and adds two acceptance checkpoints (canary demo on 08/14, final acceptance on 08/27). If we hit the canary, we suggest early exec notification to lock in the 08/27 target.

Immediate asks for you so we can execute:
- Confirm availability for the security walkthrough 08/07 (AM or PM slot).
- Confirm who in procurement has sign‑off authority so we route the SOW appropriately.

If procurement still insists on 09/05 we’ll propose an escalation path (see bottom of this thread) that includes a short term credit to bridge the gap while procurement finalizes terms.

I’ll pull Marissa and Karthik into the security cadence and SOW workstreams this morning.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0198

Attachments: Novexa_MAP_v2.xlsx, procurement_ask_summary.pdf

From: Michael Doe <michael.doe@novexa.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Asha Rao <asha@novexa.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novexa MAP: evaluation timeline at risk

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the quick turnaround and the revised MAP. Two notes from procurement:

- Procurement will not sign anything until Finance confirms net‑30 vs net‑45 terms. Our finance lead is OOO until 08/10 which means we cannot finalize a DocuSign before 08/12 at the earliest.
- Security wants the evidence package but has flagged that the engineering walkthrough needs to include a data‑flow diagram and encryption-at-rest proof points. They want that in writing prior to the call.

We are open to the pilot but procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a short credit (one week of service) if internal approvals slip past 08/15. That would remove some political friction while we complete sign‑off.

Forwarding procurement (procurement@novexa.com) into the thread — Lina handles SOW acceptance.

— Michael
Procurement Lead, Novexa

Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novexa MAP: evaluation timeline at risk

Michael / Asha / Lina —

Thanks for the clarity. Short answers and next steps:

- Credit ask: yes, we can offer a one‑week service credit to be applied if the purchase does not execute by 08/20. We’ll include the credit as a conditional clause in the one‑page SOW addendum (no upfront cost).

- Finance timing: understood about your finance lead — we will route the DocuSign to Lina and set the signature window to remain open until 08/25 so you have time after 08/12. That keeps the canary dead‑line reasonable.

- Security deliverables: Marissa will produce a short evidence memo with a data‑flow diagram and encryption bullet points by EOD 08/05. We’ll attach that ahead of the walkthrough; the walkthrough remains scheduled for 08/07 (11:00–11:45 PT) — invite has been sent.

Escalation path (if procurement cannot sign by 08/25):
1) Exec sync: Jasmine will request a 15‑minute exec alignment with Novexa VP of Platform and Redwood sales leadership to lock the go/no‑go.
2) Credit bridge: apply one‑week credit to pilot start (documented in SOW addendum).
3) Technical freeze: Redwood will provision a sandbox instance with a formal expiry date so your engineering team can complete validation without service interruption.

I’ve attached the SOW addendum draft and the MAP v2 (again) for Lina’s review. Lina — if you can confirm the single signatory name and preferred billing terms (net‑30 vs net‑45) we’ll amend the addendum and send DocuSign.

If you’d like, I can pull in our VP Sales (Marissa) for a short call tomorrow; alternatively I’ll hold escalation until EOD 08/10 when we know whether finance is back.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
